text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer—don't I seem even more
dazzling
than usual today?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I attended a tea party with
King! And
it gave me an explosive boost
in princess power!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Did you know that King doesn't down her scones in one mouthful?! She's so elegant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After spending an enjoyable day off with
her idol,
Kawakami Princess is brimming
with motivation!
